summary: Osterquill controlled SOP OQ-QA-014 Rev 03 (February 2024): control of individual-animal cards in GLP and exploratory studies, covering card issue, contemporaneous entries, corrections, dose-lot reconciliation, welfare escalation, control validity review and independent QA archive release.
header: OSTERQUILL TOXICOLOGY INC | SOP OQ-QA-014 | Rev 03 | Effective 02/20/2024

blocks.p: This procedure defines how individual-animal cards are issued, completed, corrected, reconciled and archived so that every observation in an in vivo investigation can be reconstructed.

Applies to all in vivo investigations at Osterquill. GLP studies follow every section. Exploratory investigations follow sections 5.1 to 5.5; QA audit of exploratory records is for data integrity only and does not constitute a GLP compliance statement.

list: Study Director: approves card templates and reviews control validity
In vivo technicians: make contemporaneous entries
Quality Assurance: audits cards and releases them to the archive
Animal card: the primary record of observations, body weights and dosing for one animal
Dose lot: a prepared formulation batch identified on the dose record
Control validity: confirmation that vehicle and reference groups behaved within historical expectations

blocks.p: Cards are printed from the approved template for each investigation, pre-numbered and logged in the card issue register before animal allocation.

list: Record observations at the time they are made, in indelible ink
Each entry is initialed and dated
Do not leave blank lines between entries; strike through unused space at the end of each day

blocks.p: Strike through the original entry with a single line so it remains legible, write the correction alongside, and initial, date and give the reason. Correction fluid and overwriting are not permitted.
At the end of each dosing day the dose lot on every card is reconciled against the dose preparation record. Discrepancies are reported to the Study Director the same day.
Any observation meeting a humane endpoint criterion is reported immediately to the attending veterinarian and the Study Director, and the action taken is recorded on the card.
Before the report is drafted, the Study Director reviews vehicle and reference group data against historical control ranges and documents the conclusion.
QA audits the completed card set, confirms reconciliation and correction compliance, and releases the cards to the archive with an archive index entry. Cards are retained for at least 10 years.

rows: Separated GLP and exploratory requirements; added welfare escalation
